title: Search the missing-file state
hook: A file absent from the active list may be in the exercise’s trash.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Distinguish active-only search from including deleted items.

objective: Distinguish active-only search from including deleted items.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: A file absent from the active list may be in the exercise’s trash. Which search includes the trashed note? Correct option: Include trash. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

claims.text: The note has a deleted-state flag. Including that state reveals it in this fixture; retention and recovery rules differ across real products.
